director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj dekhenge ki ek hi bhinn ko alag numbers se kaise likhte hain, aur sabse chhote numbers mein kaise. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Roti ke 4 hisse karo ya 8, khaoge utni hi. Pehli patti 1/3 rangeen hai. Doosri ka har hissa 2 mein kata: 2/6. Rang utna hi hai: yeh barabar bhinn hain. Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Ab kitne mein se kitne hisse rangeen hain?
director.card: Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Ab kitne mein se kitne hisse rangeen hain?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Pehle socho, 4 hisse 3-3 mein kate toh kul kitne bane. Phir rangeen hisson ke saath bhi wahi socho. 3/4 wali patti ka har hissa 3 mein kata, toh naya bhinn kaunsa hai?
director.card: Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Ab kitne mein se kitne hisse rangeen hain?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Haan, Hindi mein batati hoon. Socho pehli patti ka har hissa beech se kaat diya. Hisse 6 ho gaye aur rangeen 2, par rang badla nahi: 1/3 aur 2/6 ek hi cheez ke do naam hain. 3/4 wali patti ka har hissa 3 chhote hisson mein baant do. Poori patti mein ab kul kitne bane, aur unmein rang wale kitne?
director.card: 3/4 wali patti ka har hissa 3 chhote hisson mein baant do. Poori patti mein ab kul kitne bane, aur unmein rang wale kitne?

director.text: nau baarah

Haan, bilkul theek. Har rangeen hissa bhi 3 mein kata. Ulta bhi hota hai. Pehli patti mein 6 mein se 4 hisse rangeen hain. Do-do hisse milao, toh 3 bade hisse bante hain aur 2 rangeen: 4/6 = 2/3. Ab ek patti ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 8 rangeen hain. Do-do hisse mila kar bade hisse banaye: naya bhinn kya hai?
director.card: Ab ek patti ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 8 rangeen hain. Do-do hisse mila kar bade hisse banaye: naya bhinn kya hai?

director.text: pata nahi
Har do hisson par ek ghera socho. Phir ghere gino: pehle saari patti par, phir sirf rangeen hisson par. 8/10 wali patti ke saare hisse do-do milaye, toh kaunsa bhinn bana?
director.card: Ab ek patti ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 8 rangeen hain. Do-do hisse mila kar bade hisse banaye: naya bhinn kya hai?

director.text: 5 mein se 4

Sahi jawab, kyunki rangeen aur kul, dono do-do mile. Sirf numbers dekh kar nahi keh sakte ki bhinn bada hai. 1/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaato, toh 3/12 banta hai: numbers bade hain, par rang utna hi. Reena ne ek roti ka 2/3 khaaya, Mohit ne waisi hi roti ka 8/12. Kisne zyada khaaya, ya dono ne barabar?
director.card: Reena ne ek roti ka 2/3 khaaya, Mohit ne waisi hi roti ka 8/12. Kisne zyada khaaya, ya dono ne barabar?

director.text: barabar khaaya

Haan, sahi hai. 8/12 mila kar 2/3 hi banta hai. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Do ek jaisi pattiyan: pehli ke 8 barabar hisson mein se 6 rangeen, doosri ke 12 mein se 9. Hisse mila kar dekhenge, rang utna hi hai ya nahi. Dono pattiyon ko kitne bade hisson mein milaoge, ki rangeen bhi poore milein?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan pehli patti hai, 8 barabar hisson mein, aur 6 rangeen. 8 hisse bhi aur 12 hisse bhi, kitne bade hisson mein barabar mil sakte hain, ki rangeen hisse bhi poore milein?
pata nahi
Socho, kitne bade hisse banein ki 8 bhi aur 12 bhi unmein barabar baant sakein. Phir socho, rangeen hisse bhi poore baithte hain ya nahi. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: haan
Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
pata nahi, aap batao

Dono ko 4 bade hisson mein laayenge: dono pattiyan 4 barabar hisson mein mil jaati hain. Pehli patti ke do-do hisse milaye: 4 bade hisse bane, aur 6 rangeen mil kar 3. Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?
director.card: Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Pehle socho, ek bade hisse mein doosri patti ke kitne chhote hisse jaate hain. Phir rangeen chhote hisson ko bhi utne-utne milao. Jo bhi socha hai, woh bol do.
director.card: Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

seams.form: Jo bhi socha hai, woh bol do.

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

director.text: 9 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Kaatne ya milane par har hissa badalta hai: kul hisse bhi, rangeen hisse bhi. Isliye dono ginti ek saath badalti hain. 5/6 wali patti ke har hisse ko 2 barabar hisson mein kaato. Tab yeh patti kaunsa bhinn dikhayegi?
director.card: 5/6 wali patti ke har hisse ko 2 barabar hisson mein kaato. Tab yeh patti kaunsa bhinn dikhayegi?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 5/12 theek nahi. Kaatne par har rangeen hissa do chhote hisse banega, toh rangeen 5 nahi rahenge. 5/6 ka har hissa 2 mein kaato, toh kaunsa bhinn banega?
director.card: 5/6 wali patti ke har hisse ko 2 barabar hisson mein kaato. Tab yeh patti kaunsa bhinn dikhayegi?

director.text: 5/12 se baat nahi bani. Ek hissa kaato toh do bante hain. Ab saare hisse dobara gino, aur rangeen hisse bhi. Apna jawab bolo, galat ho toh bhi chalega.
director.card: 5/6 wali patti ke har hisse ko 2 barabar hisson mein kaato. Tab yeh patti kaunsa bhinn dikhayegi?

seams.form: Apna jawab bolo, galat ho toh bhi chalega.

director.text: ten twelfths

Haan, bilkul theek: 6 hisse 12 hue, aur har rangeen hissa bhi do bana, toh 5 ke 10: 10/12. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?
director.card: Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

seams.form: Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: 9 sahi nahi hai. 9 toh chhote rangeen hisson ki ginti hai; bade hisse banane par rangeen chhote hisse bhi group mein milte hain, woh 9 nahi rehte. Doosri patti 4 bade hisson mein: unmein se rangeen kitne bane?
director.card: Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

director.text: Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Dono pattiyon ke hisse alag size ke hain, isliye sirf ginti ki tulna kaafi nahi. Pehle dono ke hisse ek size ke banane honge. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Tumhari baari: doosri patti ke 12 hisse bhi 4 bade hisson mein milao. Ab 4 mein se kitne bade hisse rangeen hain?

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Iska jawab hai 6/8 aur 9/12, dono mein 4 bade hisson mein se 3 rangeen: rang barabar hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Achha, toh tumhe chauka pasand hai! Ab wapas apne kaam par. Pooja ne ek cake ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 5 liye. Waisa hi doosra cake 12 barabar hisson mein kata hai. Uska bhai kitne hisse le ki dono ka cake barabar ho?
director.card: Pooja ne ek cake ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 5 liye. Waisa hi doosra cake 12 barabar hisson mein kata hai. Uska bhai kitne hisse le ki dono ka cake barabar ho?

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhe chauka pasand hai!

director.text: Nahi, 5 theek nahi. Doosre cake ke hisse chhote hain; utne hi hisse lene se cake kam aata hai, isliye ginti badhni chahiye. 12 hisson wale cake ke kitne hisse 6 mein se 5 ke barabar honge?
director.card: Pooja ne ek cake ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 5 liye. Waisa hi doosra cake 12 barabar hisson mein kata hai. Uska bhai kitne hisse le ki dono ka cake barabar ho?

director.text: 5 se baat nahi bani. Socho, pehle cake ka har hissa kitne chhote hisson mein kate taaki 12 banein. Phir 5 hisson ke saath bhi wahi karo. Jo bhi socha hai, woh bol do.
director.card: Pooja ne ek cake ke 6 barabar hisson mein se 5 liye. Waisa hi doosra cake 12 barabar hisson mein kata hai. Uska bhai kitne hisse le ki dono ka cake barabar ho?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 10 hisse

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 6 ke 12 hisse karne par har hissa 2 mein kata, toh 5 hisse 10 chhote hisson ke barabar. Farhan ne chocolate ke 3 barabar hisson mein se 1 khaaya. Ritu ki waisi hi chocolate 9 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Farhan se zyada khaane ke liye Ritu kam se kam kitne hisse khaaye?
director.card: Farhan ne chocolate ke 3 barabar hisson mein se 1 khaaya. Ritu ki waisi hi chocolate 9 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Farhan se zyada khaane ke liye Ritu kam se kam kitne hisse khaaye?

director.text: chaar

Sahi jawab. Farhan ka 1 bada hissa Ritu ke 3 chhote hisson jitna hai; usse zyada ke liye kam se kam 4 chahiye. Ab yahi kaatna aur milana upar aur neeche ke numbers par karenge: kaatna guna se, aur milana bhaag se. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Hisse chhote karo ya bade, rang utna hi rehta hai; bas ginti badalti hai. Ab yahi baat bhinn ke dono numbers par dekhenge. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan

Pehle 3/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaata tha: neeche 4 × 3 = 12, upar 3 × 3 = 9. Upar aur neeche ko ek hi number se guna kiya, toh bhinn utna hi raha. Ab 3/4 ke barabar aisa bhinn chahiye jiska neeche 20 ho. Upar kaunsa number aayega?
director.card: Ab 3/4 ke barabar aisa bhinn chahiye jiska neeche 20 ho. Upar kaunsa number aayega?

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. 5 hisson wali patti ka har hissa 2 mein kaato, toh 3 rangeen ke 6 bante hain aur 5 ke 10. Upar ya neeche, jise bhi badlo, doosre ko bhi usi number se badlo. 2/9 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 27 ho.
director.card: 2/9 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 27 ho.

seams.form: Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 2/27 theek nahi. 2/27 mein rangeen 2 hi rahe; par 9 hisson ko 27 banane mein har hissa chhote hisson mein toota, toh rangeen hissa bhi toota. Kaunsa bhinn 2/9 ke barabar hai, jiska neeche 27 hai?
director.card: 2/9 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 27 ho.

director.text: 2/27 se baat nahi bani. Socho 2/9 ka neeche kis number se guna hokar 27 banta hai: har hissa utne chhote hisson mein kat-ta hai. Socho rangeen hisse kitne bane. Apna jawab bolo, galat ho toh bhi chalega.
director.card: 2/9 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 27 ho.

seams.form: Apna jawab bolo, galat ho toh bhi chalega.

director.text: six twenty-sevenths

Haan, bilkul theek: neeche 9 × 3 = 27, toh upar bhi 2 × 3 = 6: 6/27. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Ab 3/4 ke barabar aisa bhinn chahiye jiska neeche 20 ho. Upar kaunsa number aayega?
director.card: Ab 3/4 ke barabar aisa bhinn chahiye jiska neeche 20 ho. Upar kaunsa number aayega?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 15

Sahi jawab, kyunki neeche 4 × 5 = 20, toh upar bhi 3 × 5 = 15: 15/20. Hisse milana matlab bhaag. 10/15 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 5 se bhaag do: 10 ÷ 5 = 2, 15 ÷ 5 = 3, toh 2/3. Yeh hisson ko paanch-paanch milana hi hai. 14/35 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 5 ho.
director.card: 14/35 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 5 ho.

director.text: 14/5 sahi nahi hai. Neeche 5 karne ka matlab hai saat-saat hisse mila kar bade hisse banana; upar ke 14 hisse bhi saat-saat milte hain, 14 nahi rehte. 14/35 jitna hi bhinn, jiska neeche 5 ho, kaunsa hai?
director.card: 14/35 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 5 ho.

director.text: Nahi, 14/5 theek nahi. Dekho neeche ka 35 kis number se bhaag hokar 5 bana. Upar ko bhi usi se bhaag do. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: 14/35 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 5 ho.

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. 15 rupaye ko paanch ke sikkon mein badlo toh 3 sikke bante hain, aur 10 rupaye ke 2. Hisse bhi aise hi paanch-paanch judte hain: 10/15 = 2/3. 14/35 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 5 ho.
director.card: 14/35 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 5 ho.

director.text: two fifths

Haan, bilkul theek. Neeche 35 ÷ 7 = 5, toh upar bhi 14 ÷ 7 = 2: 2/5. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo: 2/4. 12 hisson mein 1/3 = 4/12, 2/4 = 6/12. Toh 2/4 bada hai: jodne se bhinn badal gaya. Yahan tak theek hai?
bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
